chunks: Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥasan al-Ṣaffār, from Ibrāhīm ibn Hāshim, from ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn Ḥammād, from Ibrāhīm ibn ʿAbd al-Ḥamīd, from Jaʿfar عليه السلام, who said:
“The diyah of the child of zina is the diyah of a dhimmi: eight hundred dirhams.”

key_terms.الذِّمِّيِّ: a protected non-Muslim subject under Islamic rule
key_terms.دِرْهَمٍ: silver coin used as a legal monetary measure
key_terms.دِيَةُ: financial compensation prescribed for unlawful killing or injury

ai.seo_question: What is the diyah of the child of zina according to this hadith in Tahdhib al-Ahkam?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning the diyah payable in a specific homicide or injury case. It states that the compensation for the child of zina is set at the same amount as that of a dhimmi, namely eight hundred dirhams.
